10 استبلها He milked her (namely, a camel,) without a صِرَار. (K. [See 1, first sentence.]) ―
-b2- He (a young camel) pulled off her أَصِرَّة [pl. of صِرَار] to suck her, namely, his mother. (JK.) ―
-b3- استبهل الرَّعيَّةَ He (the ruler) left the people, or subject, to themselves, (Lh, K,) to do what they would; not restraining them. (Lh, TA.) ―
-b4- اِسْتَبْهَلَتْهَا السَّوَاحِلُ (S) and استبلتهم البَادِيَةُ (K) (assumed tropical:) The shores, and the desert, left them at liberty in their abodes therein, no Sultán reaching them, so that they did what they pleased. (S, * K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
